prompt:

| Return 1m            | +6.4% |
| Return 1w            | +2.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 93% |
| 21d realized vol     | 22% |

Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:

The 93% range position (63d) suggests the stock is trading near its recent highs, which, combined with the upward trend, could signal further upside potential. While the 22% realized volatility over 21 days indicates some price movement, the consistent positive returns outweigh this, supporting a continuation of the upward trend.

DECISION: BUY
